definitions.explanation: The Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (1922–1991), the communist state centred on Russia. ソ{連|れん} is the everyday short form of ソビエト{連邦|れんぽう}, used in history lessons and in talk of the Cold War era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷戦|れいせん}→冷戦：31609_reisen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ソ{連|れん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧だった。
examples.english: The Cold War was a confrontation between the United States and the Soviet Union.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧、ソ{連|れん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抑留|よくりゅう}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧シベリア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{働|はたら}かされた。
examples.english: After the war, my grandfather was held in the Soviet Union and made to work in Siberia.

notes:
The full name is ソビエト⟦{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}→社会主義：05415_shakaishugi⟧⟦{共和国|きょうわこく}→共和国：24322_kyouwakoku⟧⟦{連邦|れんぽう}→連邦：31435_renpou⟧. For Japanese history the Soviet Union matters in particular for its 1945 entry into the war against Japan, the internment of Japanese soldiers in Siberia (シベリア{抑留|よくりゅう}), and the ⟦{北方領土|ほっぽうりょうど}→北方領土：33203_hoppouryoudo⟧ dispute.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ソ{連|れん}: the former Soviet Union
- ソ{連|れん}⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧: the collapse of the Soviet Union
- {米|べい}ソ: the US and the USSR ({米|べい}ソ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧, US–Soviet rivalry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ロシア→ロシア：31000_roshia⟧: Russia — the country today, and the core republic of the former union
